entities.summary: Martin Van Buren's tenure as the eighth president of the United States began on March 4, 1837, and ended on March 4, 1841. Van Buren, a Democrat and vice president under Andrew Jackson, took office after defeating multiple Whig Party candidates in the 1836 presidential election. Van Buren's presidency ended following his defeat by Whig candidate William Henry Harrison in the 1840 presidential election.
